rootCauses.name: AllAuditEventsPresent
rootCauses.description: All three audit events are present and within normal timing — no issue detected.
rootCauses.recommendedAction: Transfer incident to the Downstream team consuming from Collector EventHub — all three audit events are present, confirming a successful Collector publish. The issue is likely in their EventHub reader or downstream service.

rootCauses.name: MissingIngestionAuditEvent
rootCauses.description: No IngestAuditEvent recorded — the event never entered the pipeline.
rootCauses.recommendedAction: Collector on-call: re-ingest the missing event from the upstream InvoicingService — no IngestAuditEvent was recorded, so the event never entered the Collector pipeline.

rootCauses.name: MissingIndexingAuditEvent
rootCauses.description: No IndexAuditEvent recorded — the index worker failed or was skipped.
rootCauses.recommendedAction: Collector on-call: trigger a re-index for this event — the event exists in Collector Blob Storage (IngestAuditEvent is present) but the IndexAuditEvent was not recorded.

rootCauses.name: MissingPublishingAuditEvent
rootCauses.description: No PublishAuditEvent recorded — the event never reached downstream consumers.
rootCauses.recommendedAction: Collector on-call: trigger a re-publish for this event — the event exists in Collector Blob Storage (IngestAuditEvent is present) but the PublishAuditEvent was not recorded.

rootCauses.name: PublishLatencyExceedsSLA
rootCauses.description: All three audit events are present but elapsed time between IngestAuditEvent and PublishAuditEvent exceeds the SLA threshold.
rootCauses.recommendedAction: Collector on-call: investigate the publish pipeline for bottlenecks — all three audit events are present but the Ingest-to-Publish gap exceeds the SLA threshold. No data loss has occurred, but SLA has been breached.

rootCauses.name: Unknown
rootCauses.description: Evidence is ambiguous or contradictory; manual review required.
rootCauses.recommendedAction: Manual review required — evidence is ambiguous or contradictory. Escalate with the full correlated event log for this EventId.
